name: quit-command
description: /quit exits Kollab the same way a second Ctrl+C does (issue #107).

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"kollabor\":{\"llm\":{\"active_profile\":\"openai-test\",\"profiles\":{\"openai-test\":{\"provider\":\"openai\",\"model\":\"gpt-5.5\",\"base_url\":\"https://api.openai.com/v1\",\"api_key\":\"sk-test-dummy\",\"supports_tools\":false}}}},\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":false}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -s "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon; echo KOLLAB-EXITED'
